_about: Acrylic acid (1) + Cyclohexane (2): isobaric bubble temperatures at 20.0 kPa (no vapour compositions are fitted). Rows: liquid mole fraction of acrylic acid, boiling temperature in K, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Huang, G.[Guoqiang], Yao, S.[Shuaipeng], Zhao, Y.[Yuchen], Liu, L.[Liyan], Isobaric Vapor Liquid Equilibrium for Binary Systems of Toluene + Acrylic Acid, Toluene + Acetic Acid, and Cyclohexane + Acrylic Acid at 20 kPa, J. Chem. Eng. Data 56 (2011) 3914-3919
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 11, 12. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Fitted to the bubble temperatures alone (Barker's method): no set of this pair with vapour compositions passes the consistency point test, or none was measured. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.27 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
